sourceEquivalence: All downloadable assets come from the successful final tag run 38351188859. Stable-only hotfix based on v1.5.1: Linux AppImage helper working directory, macOS system Applications installer destination, version bump and validation changes. Unfinished shared-storage implementation on main is excluded. The prior unpublished failed candidate tag was replaced before any draft or public release existed; none of its artifacts are published.

linux-build.scope: Native frontend/Rust tests, helper packaging, AppImage/DEB/RPM build and exact final AppImage signature.

linux-installer.scope: Exact AppImage install/update replacement and executable mode; account, chat and default-login sentinels unchanged. This installer probe does not launch the replacement.

linux-isolation.scope: Native credential-store and isolated VS Code/helper/account guards with disposable synthetic fixtures. Real cloud authentication was not rerun for this packaging-only hotfix.

macos-build.scope: Native frontend/Rust checks, arm64 bundle inspection, exact DMG build and signed updater archive.

macos-installer.scope: Production scripts assert /Applications/Multi Codex.app and exercise native DMG copy/replacement in rewritten disposable system-path fixtures. Strict unsigned refusal, explicit opt-in, staged signature integrity, startup/restart and unchanged account/chat/default-login sentinels.

macos-isolation.scope: Native Keychain round-trip, private VS Code and Terminal launch, pinned supported standalone startup/restart with spaced/Unicode paths and peer-data guards.

windows-build.scope: Native Rust/frontend/helper checks, signed updater and exact NSIS installer packaging.

windows-installer.scope: Exact NSIS install/update/restart, visible maximized launcher, shortcuts and preserved account/chat fixtures; PowerShell 5.1 and 7 checksum-script regressions also pass.

windows-isolation.scope: Credential Manager/private ACLs, isolated VS Code and PowerShell CLI, process guards and safe refusal of an unverified moving Codex Desktop build. No fresh real cloud OAuth callback claim.

extension-linux-x64.scope: Exact packaged VSIX in native VS Code: live attachment without reloading, isolated startup/account restoration, switching, activity/approval/queue guards, continuation, recovery and usage with synthetic fixtures.

extension-darwin-arm64.scope: Exact packaged VSIX in native VS Code: live attachment without reloading, isolated startup/account restoration, switching, activity/approval/queue guards, continuation, recovery and usage with synthetic fixtures.

extension-darwin-x64.scope: Exact packaged VSIX in native VS Code: live attachment without reloading, isolated startup/account restoration, switching, activity/approval/queue guards, continuation, recovery and usage with synthetic fixtures.

extension-win32-x64.scope: Exact packaged VSIX in native VS Code: live attachment without reloading, isolated startup/account restoration, switching, activity/approval/queue guards, continuation, recovery and usage with synthetic fixtures.

launcher-window.scope: Exact final AppImage presents a visible nonblank Multi Codex welcome screen within the catalog startup allowance, with both catalog rendering flags and no sandbox bypass. Screenshot manually inspected. No broader distro/desktop-placement claim.

macos-menu-bar.scope: Exact final DMG hash matched: installed launch targets, refreshed account names/targets, Close/tray Open/Dock reopen/Quit and unchanged account metadata.

appimage-catalog.environment: Ubuntu 22.04 x64, catalog-style Firejail and raw Xvfb
appimage-catalog.scope: Catalog sandbox launch, no bundled-helper spawn failure, process survival and valid nonblank screenshot. Headless CI avoids optional portal services; required dependencies remain installed.

catalogSubmission.reason: The bundled helpers are found, but their dynamic loader cannot find libwebkit2gtk-4.1.so.0 on a host without system WebKit. The local catalog-style probe had system WebKit installed and did not cover this case. A follow-up packaging release is required; published v1.5.2 assets remain unchanged.

updaterChecks.signedPayloads: All three exact Linux/Mac/Windows payload signatures verified against the committed public key; altered bytes rejected. Manifest URLs, versions and signatures match the tested candidate assets.
updaterChecks.limits: Native Mac/Windows installers and restart passed; their in-app updater SDK installation/restart paths were not directly rerun. Apple Developer ID/notarization, broader Linux distro/desktop matrix and real Windows cloud OAuth callback remain outside this hotfix validation.
updaterChecks.installedLocalApp: Existing installed Linux launcher remains v1.5.1, SHA256 b6d06dc2b5705931fff69d6ccba229e1b3e698f720c5f1a5e50dde4f4ffd3edc. User performs the final Update-button installation.
